summary: Upgraded the release pipeline into a Distribution Alpha promotion gate. The generated provenance now uses agentos.distribution-alpha.provenance.v1, records runtime manifest hashes, Alpha rootfs and initramfs image inputs, dependency inventory, artifact hashes, Alpha service recovery smoke, full QEMU runtime smoke, gate commands, and promotion blockers.

gates.result: approved CommitSealed=true; denied EffectPrepared events=0; no external LLM required
observed handoff marker, runtime marker, and rootfs runtime manifest hash marker

acceptance_evidence.source_revision_toolchain_dependencies: Generated provenance records git commit, branch, working tree status, cargo/rustc/PowerShell versions, dependency inventory path, and dependency inventory hash.
acceptance_evidence.runtime_manifest_and_image_inputs: Generated provenance records Alpha rootfs manifest, rootfs runtime manifest hash, initramfs manifest, image inputs, and runtime artifact IDs.
acceptance_evidence.promotion_gate_coverage: Generated provenance records cargo, safety, AgentCore, adversarial, release build, initramfs, Alpha service recovery smoke, and full QEMU runtime smoke gates.
acceptance_evidence.qemu_runtime_smoke_required: scripts/build-release.ps1 now runs full scripts/boot-smoke-test.ps1 unless -SkipBootSmoke is explicitly set, and records qemu-runtime-smoke-skipped as a blocker when skipped.
acceptance_evidence.secret_hygiene: build-release.ps1 scans generated dependency inventory and provenance for raw secret-like patterns and passed.
acceptance_evidence.generated_artifact_hygiene: Release metadata, boot logs, cache, target build output, initramfs, and staged rootfs outputs remain under ignored paths and were not staged.

blocking_alpha_risks_remaining: FullRootfs validation still requires installed agentd.boot, agentd.runtime, release.provenance, and release.rootfs_manifest.
Firecracker executor profile remains planned behind SecurityExecutionEngine.
Package install isolation and untrusted content runtime workstreams remain planned.
